recipes.name: Clean dashboard card
guidance: Map tokens to existing semantic project roles.
Keep hover feedback secondary to the metric content.
rejectWhen: The card repeats information already visible in the surrounding table.
Elevation competes with a dense dashboard background.

recipes.name: Primary action button
guidance: Preserve a native button and visible focus state.
Use one primary action treatment per decision area.
rejectWhen: The action is secondary or destructive but the treatment implies primary progression.
Feedback depends on hover alone.

recipes.name: Knowledge-base content page
guidance: Keep long text on a solid reading surface.
Use decoration outside the primary body-copy column.
rejectWhen: A pattern sits directly behind long body copy.
Motion runs without communicating navigation or state.

recipes.name: Hero section
guidance: Keep the primary message readable without motion.
Remove or simplify decoration at narrow widths when it competes with content.
rejectWhen: Several entrance and attention effects run together.
The background controls text contrast unpredictably.

recipes.name: Loading state
guidance: Provide status text and retain it when motion is reduced.
Use a static or skeleton state when progress animation adds no information.
rejectWhen: Loading is expected to complete immediately.
A looping loader is used as permanent decoration.

recipes.name: Form field
guidance: Keep a persistent accessible label and visible focus.
Pair validation motion with text and programmatic state.
rejectWhen: Placeholder text is the only label.
Motion is the only validation signal.

recipes.name: Metric card
guidance: Make the value and label readable without interaction.
Reserve attention motion for meaningful changes.
rejectWhen: Pulse repeats continuously.
The card uses high decoration in a data-heavy grid.

recipes.name: Empty state
guidance: Explain the empty condition and provide the next action.
Keep decoration behind a bounded content surface.
rejectWhen: Decoration overwhelms the recovery action.
Animation loops while the state remains empty.

recipes.name: Validation feedback
guidance: Use text, state, and focus placement as the primary feedback.
Play at most one short motion cue per validation event.
rejectWhen: Motion replaces an error message.
Feedback repeats automatically.

recipes.name: Responsive media card
guidance: Reserve media space before loading to prevent layout shift.
Keep title and action available without hover.
rejectWhen: The media ratio forces important content below the viewport.
Entrance motion repeats during ordinary scrolling.
